text:
Maya: alert 09:58 UTC — sudden uptick in mTLS handshake rejects from eu-west-3 and ap-south-1. attaching quick log excerpt.
Ethan: paste an example line?
Maya: 
``n2026-04-12T09:57:41Z proxy: TLS handshake rejected: peer rejected key-id 'ephem-4f2' reason=unknown-key-id region=eu-west-3
``n
Sofia: we merged RBAC tighten yesterday that added a region condition (allow only us-east-1) to the keystore unwrap role. Rotator needs cross-region unwrap rights.
kms-bot: rotator snippet:
``n2026-04-12T09:52:10Z ERROR unwrap key=ephem-4f2 err=KMS::AccessDenied principal=svc-rotator region=eu-west-3
``n
Ethan: hypothesis: rotator can't decrypt cross-region ephemeral keys so proxies keep stale key-ids and peers with newer cert validation reject them.
Maya: options: (1) revert RBAC change (fast), (2) add explicit allow for svc-rotator kms:Decrypt on ephemeral keys, (3) force-unwrap (risky). Thoughts?
Sofia: revert then grant targeted allow. I'll roll back the PR now and craft a safer policy that includes rotator principals when region conditions are present.
oncall-bot: Incident SEC-2026-04-12-021 created. Owners: Maya, Sofia.
Sofia: rollback applied 10:03 UTC. rotator logs now show unwrap success:
``n2026-04-12T10:04:02Z INFO unwrap succeeded key=ephem-4f2 principal=svc-rotator
2026-04-12T10:04:23Z INFO rotation complete for svc-auth
``n
Ethan: restarted regional proxies in eu-west-3 and ap-south-1 to clear cached key references. watch on metrics.
Maya: error rate back to baseline by 10:10 UTC. mitigated.
Sofia: postmortem actions: add CI check that flags RBAC diffs removing rotator perms, emit structured rotator logs (key-id, principal, region, error), add alert for rotator KMS::AccessDenied >3 in 5m correlated to handshake rejects, and update RBAC templates to whitelist rotator with region conditions. I'll own the RBAC template PR.
Ethan: adding the alert + runbook snippet to security/playbooks.
Maya: marking incident mitigated and will close thread once postmortem doc is in. :thumbsup:
